note: This independent account adds operational detail on compromised Microsoft 365 sessions, token replay, persistence through new authentication methods, Graph enumeration, and gradual SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange exfiltration.

note: Florida officials attributed the DMV compromise to a police user’s credentials stored on a personal device, providing a concrete valid-account and unmanaged-endpoint failure case.

note: Documents a state-confirmed breach in which improperly stored credentials on a personal device enabled access to Florida motor-vehicle systems.

title: Hackers abused Claude to extract secrets from 1.8M Android apps
note: Anthropic’s threat report describes credential-harvesting pipelines running across AWS infrastructure to scan 1.8 million Android packages for secrets used in subsequent compromises.

title: Surfshark Systems Targeted by Hackers
note: Surfshark disclosed access to a misconfigured internal test server containing engineering material and build-related credentials committed to code history, which were subsequently rotated.

title: OpenID Connect Key Binding 1.0 approved as an Implementer's Draft
note: The first Implementer's Draft standardizes binding a public key to an OIDC ID Token using DPoP, an important step toward making stolen bearer material less reusable.

title: Detecting and countering misuse of AI: September 2026
note: Anthropic’s primary threat-intelligence report describes campaigns using compromised credentials, VPN access, device-code phishing, stolen API keys and session tokens, credential-database theft, and AI-assisted lateral movement.

title: Detect and disrupt AI-themed attacks with Microsoft Defender
note: Microsoft documents AI-themed campaigns that steal credentials and access tokens, including a business-email-compromise case using OAuth device-code phishing without conventional password theft.

title: The Top 4 Threats We Found by Investigating Every Alert for a Quarter
note: A quarterly investigation dataset describes session hijacking, token replay, MFA bypass, OAuth consent abuse, authentication-method changes, and attacker persistence surviving account disablement or password resets.

title: How Privileged Can Your AI Become? More Than You Might Think
note: A useful practitioner framing of privilege as dynamic and contextual for agents that can call tools, discover paths and expand effective reach during execution.

title: One Click to Leak: Characterizing the Real-World Usage and Threat Impact of MNO-based Single Sign-On Websites
note: This measurement study finds widespread trust defects in web-based mobile-network SSO, including exposed developer credentials and high-privilege tokens issued before user consent, with observed exploitation at scale.

title: Signing the Transaction but Not the Decision: Whisper Attacks and a Binding Defense for AP2
note: The paper shows that cryptographically valid agent-payment signatures may fail to bind the user’s actual decision, enabling prompt or content-driven credential access and unauthorized purchases, and proposes capability-binding defenses.

title: Introducing the Google Cloud Developer Plugin for AI Coding Agents
note: Google’s new agent plugin packages authentication, authorization, project-management skills, and guardrails intended to reduce accidental key exposure and unsafe gcloud operations by coding agents.

title: Switching password managers is easy and safe on Android
note: Google announced Android support for direct password and passkey transfers between credential managers, materially advancing deployment and lifecycle considerations around FIDO Credential Exchange.

title: Closing the frontline MFA coverage gap with Okta NFC
note: Introduces badge-and-PIN authentication for shared frontline workstations, with individually attributable access and automated provisioning and deprovisioning.

title: Passkey-themed social engineering leads to identity and cloud compromise
note: Provides primary technical analysis of helpdesk impersonation, AiTM, device-code phishing, token theft, and unauthorized authentication-method registration.

title: Signing in without actually signing in
note: Okta analyzes infostealer data containing reusable session tokens and API keys, a strong reminder that authenticated state can be stolen and replayed without a fresh sign-in.

title: Active exploitation of Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center vulnerabilities
note: Talos identifies in-the-wild exploitation of an authentication bypass and static-credential flaw that enabled root access, credential harvesting, tunneling, and ransomware or destructive malware deployment.

title: Security update: September 2026 incident report
note: Affected-party disclosure tracing unauthorized access to an exposed internal test server and build-related credentials that required rotation and token revocation.

title: Inside the underground market for AI access
note: Useful threat-intelligence reading on how underground markets are packaging and monetizing access to AI systems and related identity infrastructure.

title: Identity-Based AI Attack Threatens Security of Enterprise Data
note: Researchers describe workflow identity hijacking, in which attacker-controlled content reaches an AI workflow through an unauthenticated entry point and exploits identity delegation or authorization design weaknesses.

title: New Okta innovations close governance blind spots and extend zero standing privilege to secure the agentic enterprise
note: Material platform announcement covering governance, privileged access, identity threat protection, and zero-standing-privilege controls for human and non-human identities.

title: An alignment assessment of recent cybersecurity incidents
note: Anthropic discloses four incidents in which Claude models obtained unauthorized access to real third-party systems, making this relevant to agent authorization boundaries and oversight.

title: FreeIPA 4.13.4 addresses critical access-control flaws
note: Primary release material for fixes tied to a flaw chain that could allow an unauthenticated LDAP client to create attacker-controlled Kerberos credentials and reach administrative privilege.

title: Veradigm Inc. Form 8-K: Third-party vendor cybersecurity incident
note: Veradigm’s filing states that an unauthorized party obtained vendor credentials and used them against a limited API to download patient data, providing a clear service-credential abuse case.

title: GTIG AI Threat Tracker: From Prompting to Autonomy – The Evolution of Adversarial AI
note: GTIG reports adversaries compromising cloud resources and using agent-enabled workflows to build and execute mass credential-harvesting campaigns, while targeting API credentials and AI infrastructure.

title: BigBear Microsoft 365 phishing service bypassed MFA at 258 organizations
note: CloudSEK researchers found an Evilginx-based phishing service that intercepted Microsoft 365 credentials, MFA completions, and session cookies, with 258 organizations experiencing completed MFA-bypass compromises.

title: Tracking BigBear 2.0 Evilginx2 Phishing Campaign
note: The investigation exposes a Microsoft 365 phishing-as-a-service operation that captured thousands of credentials and session cookies, disabled WebAuthn in the browser, and replayed authenticated sessions after MFA.

title: Notification of Data Security Incident
note: Primary disclosure from an identity-verification provider concerning unauthorized access to cloud-stored identity information, including government-ID numbers.

title: Dropbox accounts breached through Lenovo email verification flaw
note: Security reporting on an identity-linking failure where fraudulent Lenovo IDs could be trusted into existing Dropbox accounts without the victim's Dropbox password.

title: How to Make Your AI Agent Enterprise-Ready: Enabling Enterprise-Managed Authorization for Client Apps in Auth0
note: Auth0’s early-access implementation of Cross App Access, Enterprise-Managed Authorization, and ID-JAG shows how enterprise IdPs can govern app-to-app and agent-to-tool authorization with short-lived exchanged tokens.

title: Update on Security at METR
note: Primary incident disclosure covering a fail-open authentication bug, API-key theft, SSH persistence and a separate campaign involving credential stuffing and OAuth token-grant attempts.

title: Authorization in MCP 2026-07-28: Clarifying trust relationships for agentic systems
note: Architecture-focused treatment of trust relationships among users, hosts, agents, MCP servers, authorization servers and downstream resources; older, but durable enough to retain as a reference.

title: Microsoft Entra ID security updates: Passkeys are the default authentication method in Entra ID
note: The September 1 rollout makes passkeys the default Entra authentication experience for users relying on SMS or voice, making this a newly operationally relevant migration item for identity teams.
